$comment: Fixture plugins for scripts/seed.ts. Every entry mirrors what the live indexer assembles: the raw plugin.json manifest (stored as an object; seed.ts stringifies it for the raw-text field), repo metadata, discovered skills (dirName + SKILL.md frontmatter), and the mcp.json body. All repos and orgs are fictional.

manifest.name: review-sentinel
manifest.description: Review pull requests before they reach a human reviewer. Find likely defects, missing tests, security risks, and breaking API changes.

frontmatter.name: pr-review
frontmatter.description: Check a pull request for correctness, missing tests, and breaking changes to public APIs.

frontmatter.name: security-pass
frontmatter.description: Look for injection flaws, missing authorization checks, and unsafe deserialization in a pull request.

frontmatter.name: changelog-check
frontmatter.description: Confirm that the changelog matches the code and clearly identifies breaking changes.

manifest.name: docsmith
manifest.description: Keep READMEs, API documentation, and changelogs aligned with the code while preserving hand-written sections.

frontmatter.name: api-reference
frontmatter.description: Update API reference sections from exported symbols without overwriting hand-written explanations.

frontmatter.name: readme-refresh
frontmatter.description: Update CLI flags, configuration options, and examples in the README when they no longer match the code.

frontmatter.name: changelog
frontmatter.description: Create a changelog entry from commits since the latest tag and group changes by type.

manifest.name: commit-kit
manifest.description: Turn an untidy working tree into focused commits with clear Conventional Commits messages.

frontmatter.name: write-commit
frontmatter.description: Write a Conventional Commits message that accurately summarizes the staged changes.

frontmatter.name: split-diff
frontmatter.description: Divide unrelated working-tree changes into focused commits that can be reviewed and reverted independently.

manifest.name: migration-lint
manifest.description: Check SQL migrations before deployment for long locks, missing foreign-key indexes, data rewrites, and changes that cannot be rolled back.

frontmatter.name: review-migration
frontmatter.description: Check a migration for table locks, full-table rewrites, and foreign keys without indexes, with guidance for the selected database.

frontmatter.name: rollback-plan
frontmatter.description: Create and verify a rollback migration, or explain why the change cannot be reversed safely.

manifest.name: a11y-sweep
manifest.description: Find and fix accessibility problems on rendered pages using WCAG 2.2 AA, including color contrast and incorrect ARIA.

frontmatter.name: audit-page
frontmatter.description: Audit a rendered page against WCAG 2.2 AA and prioritize issues by their effect on users.

frontmatter.name: fix-contrast
frontmatter.description: Suggest the smallest color changes needed to meet contrast requirements.

frontmatter.name: aria-review
frontmatter.description: Replace unnecessary ARIA with native HTML and correct invalid roles or attributes.

manifest.name: pg.bridge
manifest.description: Explore a PostgreSQL database safely from an MCP client: inspect schemas, understand query plans, and run read-only SQL.

manifest.name: gridwatch
manifest.description: Investigate service health from an MCP client by checking dashboards, active alerts, and SLO error-budget burn rates.

manifest.name: tracefeed
manifest.description: Follow distributed traces during a deployment so you can spot errors and performance regressions as they happen.

manifest.name: headless-pilot
manifest.description: Open pages, take screenshots, and verify rendered behavior in Chromium or Firefox from an MCP client.

manifest.name: ticketflow
manifest.description: Search and create issues from an MCP client, with a local cache for reviewing tickets when the tracker is unavailable.

manifest.name: test-pilot
manifest.description: Create unit tests from real usage, diagnose flaky tests, and inspect coverage from an MCP client.

frontmatter.name: generate-tests
frontmatter.description: Create unit tests from real call sites so expected behavior comes from how the module is actually used.

frontmatter.name: flaky-hunt
frontmatter.description: Repeat and isolate flaky tests, identify order dependencies, and report the underlying cause.

manifest.name: argus-scan
manifest.description: Check dependency updates and code changes for known vulnerabilities and exposed secrets, with live advisory data available through MCP.

frontmatter.name: dependency-audit
frontmatter.description: Review lockfile changes for known vulnerabilities and highlight newly introduced transitive dependencies.

frontmatter.name: secret-scan
frontmatter.description: Find credentials in a code change and provide rotation steps for each exposed secret.

manifest.name: frameshift
manifest.description: Understand and clean tabular data with guided Agent Skills and an embedded DuckDB MCP server.

frontmatter.name: profile-dataset
frontmatter.description: Summarize rows, columns, missing values, unique values, and outliers before changing the dataset.

frontmatter.name: clean-columns
frontmatter.description: Normalize column types, whitespace, and category values, and show exactly what changed.

manifest.name: deploy-captain
manifest.description: Plan safer releases, follow deployment events, and create clear incident notes when something goes wrong.

frontmatter.name: rollout-plan
frontmatter.description: Create a staged release plan with health checks, observation periods, and a clear rollback threshold.

frontmatter.name: incident-note
frontmatter.description: Summarize what was deployed, what failed, and what was rolled back using the deployment timeline.

manifest.name: apiscribe
manifest.description: Keep an OpenAPI description, API documentation, and SDK examples consistent, with the current description available through MCP.

frontmatter.name: openapi-sync
frontmatter.description: Compare the OpenAPI description with request handlers and update whichever one is out of date.

frontmatter.name: endpoint-docs
frontmatter.description: Write endpoint documentation with realistic request and response examples based on the OpenAPI schemas.

frontmatter.name: sdk-examples
frontmatter.description: Create ready-to-use SDK examples for each endpoint and configured programming language.
